Sandbox_IndoorClimateLite_Enabled_toolti: Keeps lightweight room-aware heat states without changing body temperature, clothing, or item insulation. Stays off while Realistic Temperature is enabled.
Sandbox_IndoorClimateLite_UpdateMinutes_: How often the occupied building or indoor zone updates. Higher values reduce CPU use. Object scans never run every frame. In multiplayer the server runs the simulation.
Sandbox_IndoorClimateLite_UnvisitedOffse: A map building with no saved climate state starts at the current outdoor temperature plus this value. Set to 0 for exactly the outdoor temperature. This does not scan or simulate unloaded buildings.
Sandbox_IndoorClimateLite_HeaterGenerato: Additional generator fuel one switched-on electric heater uses per in-game hour. Default 0.04 L/h uses about one litre per 25 hours. The standing fan always uses 0.20 L/h. Grid power uses no fuel.
Sandbox_IndoorClimateLite_PoweredTargetC: Target at or above Build 42's native 22 C powered-building baseline.
Sandbox_IndoorClimateLite_PoweredRatePer: How quickly a powered room approaches its target temperature.
Sandbox_IndoorClimateLite_PoweredLeakInf: How strongly an exterior open door or window pulls its powered room toward outdoor temperature. 0 ignores breaches while powered; 1 gives outdoor air full influence. The same share weakens heaters and fans in a leaking room.
Sandbox_IndoorClimateLite_SealedLossPerH: Sealed room heat-loss rate per hour
How quickly a closed room drifts toward outdoor temperature after power loss. Lower values retain heat longer.
Sandbox_IndoorClimateLite_BreachMultipli: Maximum heat-loss multiplier when nearby doors or windows are open or broken.
Sandbox_IndoorClimateLite_ScanRadius_too: Nearby fallback radius used for player-built rooms and while a map building's cached exterior-opening scan is incomplete. Default 5 checks at most 121 squares.
Sandbox_IndoorClimateLite_NativeBridge: Feed retained warmth to vanilla climate
Sandbox_IndoorClimateLite_NativeBridge_t: Uses a radius-one native heat source so vanilla thermoregulation can feel retained room warmth. In multiplayer it is placed on the server too, where the game works out body warmth. It never writes body temperature.
Sandbox_IndoorClimateLite_DebugLogging_t: Writes one indoor-temperature line per player and scheduled update, and the simulation's cost once an in-game hour. In multiplayer they go to the server's log.
